lines.en: I show up at the porn shop to find it in...slightly different condition than normal.
Previously, all of the posters covering the wall had seemed relatively low-resolution- like they were printed out on paper and just taped up or something.
But it looks like a whole plethora of new posters have been hung now. And they’re all advertising the same thing.
The fuck is Hero's Harem Guild?
I take a look around to see if I can spot Makoto, but I-
: This...fucking...stupid...game...
: Makoto? Where are you?
: Over here, bashing my head against a wall.
: What do you want?
: Uhh...porn? Did you forget what you sell here?
: Go home and watch porn on your computer.
: Nah, I think I’ll just watch whatever you’re-
: Are you...fishing?
: What does it look like I’m doing, genius? Of course I’m fishing.
: Why?
: Some weird guy showed up an hour ago and just started hanging up all these weird posters for some video game he’s making.
: A video game? But this is a porn shop.
: They have pornographic video games too, you know. We just haven’t really sold any since we opened.
: But my mom said that we need to start selling them now since we’re getting less and less male customers.
: Okay, but that still doesn’t really explain why you’re fishing.
: Yes, I’m well aware. I have no idea why I have to do this either.
: My wrist is starting to hurt and everything.
: Correct me if I’m wrong here, but hurting your wrist playing a porn game sounds kind of par for the course.
: Ha ha ha. I’m funny. My name is Sensei. I make masturbation jokes. I’m a boy. Ha ha ha ha.
: Woah, what’s gotten into you all of a sudden?
: All I want to do is have sex with cute girls and beat this game but I need to fish before I can do that!
: What does fishing have to do with sex?
: Hell if I know! If you ever try to win my heart with a fish, I’ll kill you! I swear!
: I didn’t need a fish to win your heart. I just needed to get you alone in the back room.
: Yeah, well...You’re a jerk. Take that. Jerky McJerkface.
: Harsh.
: Really? Well, there go my plans for next weekend.
: Here I was hoping to win you over with exactly that.
: You’re the absolute worst. Even worse than whatever this weird fish is.
Makoto fills up a meter on the screen and a fish pops into her inventory.
: What’s that one called? It looks like it has a name.
: The game says it’s called a Danee fish.
: Does it...do anything?
: I don’t know. But it’s ugly and I’m throwing it back.
: Do we get to have sex with the girls now? I like the one with the orange hair on the poster in front of you. Bang her first.
: That’s Lucy. She’s the best. I think I need more fish before we can sleep with her, though.
: Just how many fish do you need?...
: Let’s see...I just have to bring these to some weird girl who buys them and-
: Done with the prologue yet, dear?
: Huh?
: Mom?! Wh-What are you doing?
: And what are you wearing?!
: What’s wrong with what I’m wearing? I didn’t have the energy to get dressed. Is that a crime?
: It is when you run a business!
: That’s disgusting! We sell things like that here?!
: How do you not know that?...It’s one of the most popular choices among older men.
: I’m personally into the more...individual-focused tapes. Groups of more than three get kind of hard to follow.
: Guh...
: Ahh, a man of culture I see. I’m Maki, the store’s-
Makoto’s mother suddenly pauses and observes me for a second.
It’s almost like she’s...
...Recognizing someone.
Oh God. This could be bad.
: Aren’t you...my daughter’s[school] teacher?
: Wait, Mom! You can’t just be...asking the customers for their identities! Isn’t there like...a law against that or something.
: There isn’t. And if you’ve been selling things to our customers without checking their IDs, I’m grounding you for the next month.
There’s no way out of this. There can’t be.
I can’t imagine that would make things any easier for Makoto.
: That’s right. It’s nice to see you again, Maki.
: Likewise. Thanks for stopping in.
: This...Uhh...
: It’s just that ever since her father was drafted, I’ve been running everything myself and-
: What? No, that’s fine. I don’t care about that at all.
: Wait, really? I could have sworn this wasn’t going to end well for anybody.
: Could it be that we’re all going to have a happy ending after all?
: That’s not a massage joke, by the way. We don’t offer those here.
Heh.
If only she knew...
Actually, no. It would be catastrophic if she knew.
Let’s avoid that at all costs.
: Mom!
: What do you think you’re doing?! You can’t make jokes like that in front of my teacher!
: I can’t?! But those are the only jokes I know!
: That’s because all you ever think about is porn!
: I think about other things too! Like...dogs...and...the...stock market.
: She’s not this bad in[school], is she? I’d feel horrible if that were the case.
: Mom! Stop!
: Makoto is actually the top student in class. She’s actually been even more helpful than usual lately.
: Sensei...
: Really? That’s great news.
: In fact, to celebrate such a joyous occasion, how about I give you 50%% off anything in the store?
: My daughter is off-limits, though. Got it, Sensei?~
I go through a quick inner struggle in figuring out whether or not it would be acceptable to joke back about that, but I decide against it for the time being.
I should at least get to know Maki a little better before playing along with her mildly perverted sense of humor.
: Thanks a lot. I’ll take a look around now.
: Wait, really? I can go?
: Are you going to be okay closing up? You worked all day, didn’t you?
: Define “work” because I kind of just sat around for a really long time. I’m fine to close up.
: Do you need me to call you a cab back to the dorms?
: No, it’s fine. I’ll walk. The weather’s kind of nice anyway.
And to that, my dear Makoto, I say-
“I make no promises.”
Makoto gathers up a few things she had stashed behind the counter and exits the store after saying her goodbyes.
: All set?
: Yeah. This will be all.
Maki scans the DVD with one of those cool price gun things and doesn’t pay much mind to what’s on the cover.
: I’m going to give you my number as well. Is that okay?
: What? Really? Why?
: Same reason I gave it to you at the last parent-teacher meeting. To check in on my daughter.
: And since you hadn’t called yet, I figured you might have lost the number or something, so...
Huh...did I already have Maki’s number in my contact list?
I can’t remember ever really sorting through it, now that I think about it.
: Sure. I’ll definitely do that.
: Makoto’s fine, though. She’s actually pretty remarkable.
: Well she doesn’t get it from me, I can tell you that much.
: 1500 Yen is your total after the discount.
: Oh, right. Sorry.
I take some money out of my pocket and slide it across the table to Maki.
It’s exact change, so she just shoves it into the register and slams the drawer.
: Come back soon, okay? And be sure to try out that new game we’re promoting.
: There’s one girl in it who gets turned on by getting hit in the head with a frying pan. It’s sweet.
: I’ll keep it in mind. Thanks for the recommendation.
: Don’t mention it! I’ll see you soon.
: That you will.
I take the receipt with Maki’s number on it and type it into my phone as I walk out of the store.
I should try giving her a call sometime soon...
Congratulations! You now have Maki’s phone number.
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
